authorization: User requested removing old failing regressions from the active tests.
reason: Historical SoC/diagnostic suites are excluded from active commands. The old EV-protection suite incorrectly required every EV to have a positive current command; current control serializes starts. Its useful attribution and 14 scheduler scenarios are retained in the replacement, allowing a 0 A command only with denied permission and the explicit serialized-start reason. Physical protection and shared grid-limit assertions remain strict. New EV4 zero-command/freshness/permission/stop checks were added.
unchangedTests: Other existing tests were not modified or removed.
